title: Generalizing Lusztig's total positivity II : geometric properties
summary: Positive structures in Lie groups with respect to a subset $Θ$ of the set of positive roots provide a generalization of Lusztig's total positivity in split real Lie groups to the setting of general real semisimple Lie groups. In [GW25] Lie groups G admitting a positive structure were classified and many key properties of the unipotent positive semigroups were established. In this article we focus on the positive semigroup in G. We establish key geometric properties of elements in the positive semigroup.
